goal: Pick up the mallet from its stand and strike the 8 xylophone keys one after another, from left to right, lifting the mallet clear of the keys between strikes.
instruction_templates: Pick up the mallet and strike all xylophone keys from left to right.
success: Eight strikes must be completed in the order key 0, 1, ... 7 (the xylophone's functional regions bbox_0..bbox_7 / hit_0..hit_7, intended to be left to right). A strike on key i is a single moment where BOTH: the mallet's active functional point 'beat' (the mallet head) is horizontally (XY) inside the 4-point quadrilateral 'bbox_i' of the xylophone (boundary counts), AND (z of mallet 'beat' point minus z of xylophone 'hit_i' point) lies strictly between 0.01 m and 0.036 m (i.e. the head is 1.0 to 3.6 cm above the hit point of that key).

After each of the strikes 0..6 the mallet must be raised: the z of the mallet root pose (root, not the head) must exceed by more than 0.025 m (strict) its z at the moment the strike was registered (the root pose is re-recorded at the action when the strike stage passes).
After strike 7 nothing more is required (no final lift, no return home).
evaluation: Staged and sequential, 15 stages in this order: strike0, lift, strike1, lift, strike2, lift, strike3, lift, strike4, lift, strike5, lift, strike6, lift, strike7. The reward manager is evaluated only once per action (after the sim sub-steps of that action are finished), never between sub-steps. In each evaluation the FIRST pending stage of the check list is tested (every condition in it, all at that same moment; a condition that is a nested list is an OR); when it passes it is removed permanently (never re-verified later) and the next stage becomes pending; at most one stage is removed per action. Therefore at least 15 actions are needed, and a strike or a lift only counts if it is observed at an action boundary (a hit that happens and ends between two actions is invisible). Order matters: strikes on the wrong key or earlier keys are simply ignored (no penalty), only the pending stage is tested. Reward is 1.0 only when the check list is empty (and no query/trigger counter is violated); the episode is declared a success as soon as reward >= 0.999 after an action, and ends as a failure if the action counter reaches step_lim without that, or earlier if the environment is flagged failed (query counter exceeded, see below). No final_check list is registered by this task, so the final-check logic at step_lim adds nothing. There is no early failure condition.
objects: mallet_stand: stand holding the mallet (Rigid, 1), table-frame x in [-0.45,0.0], y in [-0.2,0.0], random yaw up to +-30 deg, margin 0.02 (place_tag 'up_side' if x in [-0.2,0.05], 'up' if x in [-0.45,-0.2])
mallet: the striking mallet (Rigid, 1), starts resting on the stand (relative position (0,0) on the stand)
xylophone: 8-key xylophone (Geometry, static, 1), table-frame x in [-0.1,0.0], y in [-0.05,0.05], random yaw up to +-15 deg
needs_memory_or_language: none (the order left to right is fixed by the instruction; the key indices bbox_0..bbox_7 are internal to the xylophone asset).
physics_kind: rigid (mallet) hitting a static geometry; the strike is purely geometric (no sound/contact force check)
notes: Success is geometric: the mallet head only has to be in a 1.0-3.6 cm height window above the hit point while over the key's footprint, it does not need to touch the key. The hit points' exact heights and the bbox_i polygons are defined in the xylophone asset metadata (not available statically), and the mapping of key index 0..7 to 'left to right' is assumed from the instruction. The lift stage is measured on the mallet ROOT z (not the head), relative to the pose captured at the strike action, so a tilt of the mallet could change the root height. Dwell is not required (one action boundary inside the window is enough). Because only one stage is advanced per action, strike and subsequent lift cannot both happen inside a single action. The mallet must be grasped first (it starts on the stand).
